# Margea Travel

> Direct bookings for luxury vacation rentals, tours, and activities across Mexico's Riviera Maya — Cancún, Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Akumal, Puerto Morelos, and Isla Mujeres.

Margea is a Riviera Maya travel and property-management company. Guests book vacation rentals and curated tours directly (no platform fees), with 24/7 concierge and instant confirmation. Property owners list with our management program.
